scripts.title: RedFox Server Bowser
scripts.features:
🦊 RedFox Server Browser
=========================

DESCRIPTION:
------------
RedFox Server Browser is a custom Roblox UI tool that lets you browse, join, and manage public servers in any game you're currently playing.

It uses a dark red-themed interface and provides utility buttons for teleporting, copying server Job IDs, and monitoring simulated ping.

FEATURES:
---------
✔ Live Server List:
  - Displays up to 100 active public servers for the current game.

✔ Join Button:
  - Join any server instantly via a “Join” button.

✔ Player Count:
  - Shows number of players currently in each server.

✔ Simulated Ping:
  - Displays ping (between 40–150ms, auto-updates every second).

✔ Copy Job ID (per server):
  - Each server card includes a “📋 Copy Job ID” button to copy its unique identifier.

✔ Copy MY Job ID:
  - A button that copies your current Job ID (game.JobId) to clipboard.

✔ Manual Job ID Join:
  - Enter any server Job ID manually and teleport directly.

✔ RedFox Theme:
  - Custom UI with red/black styling, gradients, rounded corners, and hover effects.

REMOVED FEATURES:
-----------------
✘ Refresh Button (was causing race conditions)
✘ Sort by Player Count or Ping
✘ Hide Full Servers

USAGE:
------
1. Execute the script in your Roblox executor.
2. View the list of public servers.
3. Click "Join" or "Copy Job ID" for any server.
4. Use the textbox to manually teleport via Job ID.
5. Use “📋 Copy MY Job ID” to share your current server.


Updates: 

Added 📋 "Copy MY Job ID" button

Added 🔁 "Rejoin Server" button

Added 🔁 "Refresh" button (rebuilds UI)

Added 🟢 "YOU'RE HERE" label for current server

Hid 📋 "Copy Job ID" button for current server

Fixed server duplication after refresh

Made UI fully draggable

Applied RedFox gradient + rounded corners

Server ping updates every 1s

Proper "Join" button hover effect

TextBoxes now support Enter-to-join

All UI uses consistent red/black RedFox theme
